purpose: Fresh-holdout, precision-first coverage-witness calibration after Stage B showed that discrete-harmonic continuation drifts across large curved holes. Stage C uses only visible annulus geometry, curvature-aware material-coordinate polynomial continuation, and explicit model-disagreement abstention before consulting the independent surface prediction.
claim_boundary: A pass would establish that a conservative visible-only continuation ensemble can recover correctly localized independent omission witnesses on six previously untouched PHerc0139 regions while rejecting frozen adjacent-winding controls. It would justify an experimental diagnostic, not whole-scroll completeness or target-scroll validity.

predecessor.observed_failure_mechanism: Discrete harmonic material-grid continuation accumulated large hidden-surface error as deletion size increased, causing low target precision and two wrong-wrap false accepts. Frozen Stage-B thresholds are not relaxed.
predecessor.design_response: Use fresh holdout centers and abstain when two curvature-aware visible-only continuations disagree.

fresh_holdout_selection.eligibility_rule: From the original 32 frozen groups, exclude Stage-B centers and retain only centers whose 51x51 material-grid evaluation window fits completely inside the 291x262 TIFXYZ grid.
fresh_holdout_selection.selection_rule: For six samples from N=19 eligible groups, select zero-based ranks floor((i+0.5)*N/6) for i=0..5.
fresh_holdout_selection.no_replacement_rule: No selected center may be replaced because of continuation, prediction, CT, or scoring outcomes.

deletion_protocol.hidden_firewall: All TIFXYZ XYZ values and validity bits inside the active deletion are removed before fitting, uncertainty estimation, normal construction, or independent-prediction sampling. Hidden reference is scoring-only.
deletion_protocol.rectangle_rule: Odd square centered at the frozen material-grid center.

continuation_ensemble.coordinate_system: material-grid centered coordinates normalized by evaluation half-width 25: u=(x-cx)/25, v=(y-cy)/25
continuation_ensemble.visible_training_points: All visible valid TIFXYZ vertices inside the 51x51 evaluation window and outside the active hidden rectangle.
continuation_ensemble.analytic_normals: Compute dXYZ/dx and dXYZ/dy analytically from each polynomial and use unit cross(dXYZ/dx, dXYZ/dy). Normal sign is arbitrary.

consensus.rule: Generate an independent-prediction ray only where degree-2 and degree-3 predicted XYZ positions differ by <=8 voxels and absolute normal cosine is >=0.9. Otherwise abstain.

visible_only_validation.definition: Before final fitting, withhold visible valid cells in the two-cell inner collar immediately outside the hidden rectangle. Fit each model on the remaining visible window and score degree-3 prediction on the held-out collar. This validation never uses hidden cells.

continuation_ensemble.conditioning_requirement: Each fit must have at least four times as many visible training points as basis terms and finite least-squares coefficients.

normal_ray_decomposition.run_definition: Maximal contiguous supported integer-offset sequence; no response-dependent smoothing.
normal_ray_decomposition.guard_band: 8 < absolute run midpoint < 12 is ambiguity and is never target coverage.
normal_ray_decomposition.target_selection: Nearest absolute target-run midpoint; negative wins exact ties.

scoring.correct_target_definition: Selected target witness is within 8 voxels of the original hidden TIFXYZ point at the same material index.
scoring.omission_definition: Correct target witness is >8 voxels from the counterfactual submitted w035 surface with the active patch removed.
scoring.wrong_wrap_rejection_definition: Frozen wrong-wrap point is >8 voxels from every selected target witness in the variant.
scoring.competitor_recovery_definition: In the 41x41 variant, a competitor coordinate emitted at the center material index lies within 8 voxels of the frozen wrong-wrap point.

decision_rule.missing_or_invalid_variant_policy: Fail; do not replace a region or relax a threshold.
decision_rule.pass_interpretation: A pass promotes the polynomial-consensus method only to an experimental diagnostic and supports replication with a second independent witness family. It does not prove recto completeness.
